title: Menus
description: Native classic-menu editor (Appearance → Menus). Create / rename / delete menus, add custom-link / page / term items, reorder with explicit up-down-indent-outdent controls plus a numeric order field (no drag-and-drop), and assign menus to theme locations. Classic-theme only — disabled with a Site-Editor pointer on block themes.

documentation.purpose: Native editor for WordPress classic navigation menus, rebuilding Appearance → Menus (`nav-menus.php`) over the nav-menu REST entities. It serves site authors on classic themes who still rely on `wp_nav_menu()` locations. Authors pick a menu from a selector (or create / rename / delete one), add items of three kinds — custom links, existing pages/posts, or existing categories/tags via lightweight relational pickers — reorder and nest items with explicit Up / Down / Indent / Outdent buttons plus a numeric Order field (Option B: no drag-and-drop, per issue #120), and assign the menu to theme-declared locations. On a block theme the app short-circuits to a disabled panel that points to the Site Editor's Navigation block and offers the classic `nav-menus.php` iframe fallback, because classic menus are superseded there. It consumes the shared `workspace.theme-support` block-theme signal (stamped PHP-side by `WP_Admin_Workspaces_Appearance_Menu`) to make that determination.

reads.purpose: All menu containers — the menu selector + the active menu's name and assigned `locations`.
Items belonging to the selected menu, built into a depth-first tree (parent + menu_order).
Theme-declared menu locations (keyed by name) for the assignment checkboxes.
Relational picker options when adding a Page/Post item (published only). Fetched only while the item-modal kind is `post_type` (issue #115 stand-in).
Relational picker options when adding a Category/Tag item. Fetched only while the item-modal kind is `taxonomy`.

Block-theme signal (from `window.wpAdminWorkspaces.config.workspace['theme-support']`, stamped by `WP_Admin_Workspaces_Appearance_Menu`). When `block-theme` is true the app disables itself and shows the Site-Editor / iframe fallback.

writes.purpose: Create a new menu from the Create-menu modal.
Rename a menu, or assign / unassign theme locations (writes the menu's `locations` array).
Delete the active menu (`force: true` — menus have no trash).
Add a menu item (custom link / page-post / term) to the active menu.
Edit an item's label / link / order, or reorder via Up/Down/Indent/Outdent (which PATCH `parent` + `menu_order`).
Remove a menu item (`force: true` — menu items have no trash).

states.renders: Centered spinner while the menu list resolves.
Disabled panel explaining classic menus are replaced by the Navigation block, with links to the Site Editor (#/site-editor) and the full-fidelity classic Menus iframe screen (#/nav-menus).
Empty-state copy prompting the author to create their first menu.
Menu selector + theme-location checkboxes + item tree with reorder controls + Add item / Create menu / Rename / Delete menu actions.
Centered spinner in the item-list area while the selected menu's items resolve.
Modal with item-type selector, relational/url fields, navigation label, and numeric Order field.
Modal with a single Menu name field (create or rename).

interactions.trigger: Select a menu from the dropdown
interactions.effect: Sets the active menu id; its items + location assignments refetch.
Opens the menu-name modal; on save `saveEntityRecord('root','menu', …)`, invalidate the menu query, snackbar, and (on create) select the new menu.
`deleteEntityRecord('root','menu', id, { force: true })`, invalidate, clear selection, snackbar.
`saveEntityRecord('root','menu', { id, locations })` with the location added/removed; invalidate the menu query.
Opens the item modal in create mode seeded with the next sibling order.
`saveEntityRecord('root','menuItem', payload)` — custom → `type:custom`+url; relational → `type`+`object`+`object_id`. Invalidate the items query + snackbar.
guards: custom link requires a non-empty URL
relational item requires a selected object_id

interactions.trigger: Click Up / Down on an item
interactions.effect: Swaps the item with its adjacent sibling and PATCHes the changed `menu_order` values (contiguous, gap-free).
Reparents the item under its immediately-preceding sibling at the end of that sibling's children (`parent` + `menu_order`).
guards: item is not the first among its siblings

interactions.effect: Promotes the item to its grandparent level, positioned right after its old parent; reparents then settles sibling orders.

a11y.focus-management: Modals (item / menu-name / delete-confirm) use `@wordpress/components` Modal, which traps focus and restores it to the trigger on close. Reorder controls are icon buttons with `aria-label`s (Move up / Move down / Indent / Outdent).

constraints.note: Both `root/menu` and `root/menuItem` have no trash. `deleteEntityRecord` must pass `{ force: true }` or the request 400s.
Menus are private-by-default since WP 6.8 — all reads pass `context: 'edit'` (the entity default for these three) so `title.raw` and the full item fields are returned.
Reorder is explicit (Up/Down/Indent/Outdent + numeric Order field) — Option B per issue #120. Swap in drag-reorder when the upstream primitive (#168) lands.
Page/Post and Category/Tag pickers are a lightweight `useEntityRecords` + SelectControl stand-in (capped at per_page 100). Replace with the shared relational picker primitive when #115 lands.
Consumes `workspace.theme-support` (shared with #121). On a block theme the editor is disabled — classic menus are superseded by the Site Editor's Navigation block.
Menu names + item titles may carry HTML entities. Pass through `decodeEntities` before rendering and when seeding modals, or re-save double-encodes.
All menu / menu-item mutations call `invalidateResolution('getEntityRecords', …)` with the exact query key — `saveEntityRecord` / `deleteEntityRecord` do not bust the parent query.

design-system-leakage.purpose: Toolbar, item rows, reorder icon buttons, modal inputs, headings.
Menu / object pickers, location checkboxes, modal container, loading filler — WPDS 0.12 gaps.
Success snackbars / error banners for every mutation.
Add-item / create-menu icon, and the reorder control icons resolved through the kernel icon registry.
